flash_696458.description: Amid reports of talks with anti-Netanyahu bloc, Degel HaTorah MKs meet leading rabbis to discuss party's next moves.

flash_696464.description: The Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) announced that North Korean hackers are responsible for stealing more than $6 billion in digital assets from cryptocurrency exchange Binance.

flash_696463.description: Trump says Iran wants a nuclear deal but cannot be trusted, warns remaining sites could be struck within minutes, and refuses to rule out renewed military action.

flash_696462.description: Nancy Pelosi condemns the Israel-related positions of Zohran Mamdani and Abdul El-Sayed, but her spokesperson says she still supports El-Sayed's Senate bid.

flash_696460.description: US President Donald Trump and Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu spoke amid ongoing tensions with Iran, The Wall Street Journal reported.

flash_696484.description:
Jerusalem District police and Border Guard soldiers arrested four minors from the A-Tur neighborhood yesterday, on suspicion of throwing Molotov cocktails at Jewish homes in the eastern part of the city.

The suspects were recorded at the time of the act and were located following investigative actions. The court extended the detention of the four until Wednesday. The police investigation continues.

flash_696483.description: Four patients underwent pacemaker implantation using a technique designed to improve electrical coordination between the heart's atria and reduce heart rhythm disturbances.

flash_696481.description: Journalist Michael Shemesh outlines eight mistakes behind Shas's 2026 election defeat, criticizing Aryeh Deri and his associates for losing touch with voters and reality.

flash_696479.description:
Police arrested 14 foreign citizens on suspicion of violating a legal order and staying in a closed military area near the Palestinian Authority village of Luban a-Sharqiya, south of Shechem.

The suspects were transferred to the Population Authority for a hearing, prior to their removal from Israel.

flash_696478.description:
United States President Donald Trump declared that Iran's nuclear program has been eliminated, but said there are still one or two sites that need to be addressed.

Trump added: "We can do it in ten minutes. Ten minutes. We have the plans for it."

flash_696476.description: On the anniversary of the death of Ze'ev (Jabo) Erlich, Rabbi Itzik Amitai reveals an unsent letter rebuking his eulogy for his rabbi as dishonoring their family and now asks for public forgiveness.

flash_696474.description: The oil tanker traffic tracking website TankerTrackers reported that a shipment of two million barrels of oil from Iran arrived in China, three and a half months after it set off.

flash_696472.description: Following Shas's electoral setback, party chairman Aryeh Deri is weighing his political future, including retirement, resignation from the Knesset, or appointment as party president.

flash_696470.description: A Swiss complaints panel rules that a broadcaster discriminated against Israeli bobsledder Adam Edelman by questioning his Olympic participation over his views.

flash_696468.description: Secretary of State Marco Rubio says Trump has set no deadline for negotiations with Iran and has made no decision on renewed strikes, but military options remain open.

flash_696466.description: A senior Religious Zionist Party official criticizes Noam, arguing that its decision to run independently weakened both his party and the national camp.

flash_696461.description:
Deni Avdija and the Portland Trail Blazers secured a 112-90 road victory over the Utah Jazz, improving their season record to 4-1.

Avdija finished the game with 24 points, five rebounds, and two assists.

flash_696459.description: A wave of protests over the rising cost of living, the state of the education system, and the policies of President Emmanuel Macron.

flash_696505.description: IDF troops operating near Al-Khiam uncover weapons inside a civilian home, Hezbollah symbols in a children's room, and a storage site for explosive drones.

flash_696504.description: IDF troops demolish the homes of two terrorists who killed soldiers at Judea Junction, with members of the fallen soldiers' battalion taking part.

flash_696503.description: US Ambassador Mike Huckabee told Newsmax that Netanyahu’s stronger-than-expected election showing has shifted the political picture, but the battle to form a government is only beginning.

flash_696501.description: Tel Aviv Stock Exchange CEO Ittai Ben-Zeev urges party leaders to form a broad government, warning that political deadlock threatens economic growth.

flash_696500.description: President Donald Trump could emerge weakened from the upcoming US midterm elections, potentially limiting his ability to take significant action against Iran.

flash_696499.description:
National Security Minister and Otzma Yehudit chairman Itamar Ben Gvir addressed the allegations against a Knesset member, stating that if it emerges that foreign funds were used to bribe voters and manipulate election results, it would constitute "a shocking corruption scandal and a severe blow to democracy and the sovereignty of the State of Israel."

Ben Gvir demanded that, if the allegations are proven, the Knesset member be prosecuted and sentenced to actual imprisonment. He added that if it is established that the election results were manipulated through the use of these funds, steps should be taken to hold new elections as soon as possible. "We will not allow anyone to steal our elections. Anyone who sells elections for money belongs in prison, not in the Israeli Knesset," he declared.

flash_696498.description: Border Police use drone to locate suspects hiding in wooded hills near the Tarkumiya Crossing, directing IDF forces to apprehend them.

flash_696496.description: Eisenkot has already begun making overtures to United Torah Judaism. What are the chances that these preliminary contacts will develop into a significant political move, and what will Eisenkot have to offer in return?

flash_696495.description:
Initial report of an Israeli resident being attacked by Palestinian rioters and anarchists near Jackson's farm, near the community of Gittit in the Jordan Valley.

MDA teams called to the scene are providing medical treatment to the injured man, whose condition is described as mild.

flash_696494.description: US health secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. praises Jewish contributions to humanity, hails Israel as a bastion of freedom and accuses Iran, Gulf states and the Muslim Brotherhood of fueling anti-Israel propaganda.

flash_696493.description: Dimona Mayor Benny Biton says the prime minister wants a unity government and suggests that President Herzog and Trump intervene to broker an agreement with Eisenkot.

flash_696492.description: Otzma Yehudit chairman and National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir acknowledged that he had expected a better election result and warned the haredi parties against joining a left-wing government.

flash_696491.description: Tensions run high in Shas following its election collapse: 'Instead of taking responsibility, he is trying to revive the 2014 resignation stunt so they will beg him to stay.'

flash_696490.description: According to an i24NEWS report, a Knesset member from the Joint List received hundreds of thousands of shekels in cash, raising suspicions of bribery and money laundering.

flash_696489.description: A 15-year-old allegedly broke into an Afula synagogue after a family dispute, threw holy books onto the floor, poured liquid over them, set toilet paper rolls on fire and stole a charity box.

flash_696488.description: Ahead of consultations at the President's Residence, Herzog calls on party leaders to acknowledge the election results and work to prevent another election.

flash_696487.description: Election funding for the 26th Knesset totals NIS 300 million. Technical splits by five lists added NIS 12.8 million, with another NIS 24 million expected in ongoing funding over a full term.

flash_696486.description: Former hostage Rom Braslavski criticized Channel 12 after a report omitted Moshe Feiglin, whose grandson was killed in Gaza, from a list of bereaved MKs.

flash_696485.description: Ahavat Hashem Gordon was subjected to antisemitic remarks while filming a video in Thailand. Following the incident, he shared a message with his followers: "It's not worth the risk."

flash_696482.description: Four years ago, Likud dominated the ballot boxes in Nof HaGalil. Now, the Joint List leads by thousands of votes.

flash_696480.description: Police have located the ATV stolen from the family home of Yossi Tahar, a Shin Bet operative who fell on October 7, and arrested a suspect in connection with the theft.

flash_696477.description: Dozens of haredi protesters attempt to block the road leading to the IDF Induction Center at Tel Hashomer in protest against the arrest of draft evaders.

flash_696527.description: The division of the right goes deeper than the proliferation of doomed small parties. It comes down to the way in which we attempt to make our influence felt. Opinion

flash_696526.description: 160 Israelis run the New York City Marathon for Shalva in memory of fallen IDF officer Harel Birenstock, who ran the same race two years earlier.

flash_696525.description: Jonathan Elkhoury, who fled to Israel at age nine following threats from Hezbollah, has been accepted into the Foreign Ministry's cadet course.

flash_696523.description: Israeli assessments put Iran's arsenal at 1,700 ballistic missiles and 80,000 drones, as the US reinforces its regional forces despite deployment gaps.

flash_696521.description: The Likud party criticized the Central Elections Committee chairman over his determination that suspicions of foreign funding do not undermine the election results.

flash_696519.description: Axios reports Netanyahu is urging Trump to resume strikes on Iran after the US midterms, while Trump prefers to give diplomacy more time.

flash_696517.description: Hollywood director Michael Mann, 83, was injured by an accidental discharge during target practice at a Los Angeles shooting range.

flash_696515.description:
Naftali Bennett's Together party will recommend Yashar party chairman Gadi Eisenkot to the President as its candidate to form the next government.

In a statement, the party said the decision was made in accordance with Bennett's promise to respect the will of the voters, adding that Bennett had informed Eisenkot of his decision.

flash_696514.description: Elections Committee chief Noam Sohlberg says Israel's election results will stand despite serious foreign funding suspicions, as a joint investigation proceeds.

flash_696512.description: Rabbi Dov Lando's aide declines to rule out supporting Eisenkot, saying UTJ's future alliances will be determined by the party's rabbinical leadership.

flash_696510.description: A yeshiva in Tzfat has been ordered to close for 30 days after an inspection by Israel Fire and Rescue Services uncovered serious fire safety violations

flash_696508.description: President Isaac Herzog will meet with British singer-songwriter Boy George on Monday in recognition of his public support for the Jewish people and Israel.

flash_696506.description: A growing dispute within the Democratic Party over support for Israel is threatening to undermine the party's chances in one of the most closely watched Senate races ahead of Tuesday's US midterm elections.

flash_696502.description: Border Police officers located 74 illegal residents during a raid on a residential building in Kafr Qassem, as part of an ongoing nationwide crackdown on illegal entry and residency in Israel.

flash_696537.description: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi says talks through Qatari mediators are progressing but no deal has been reached, as Trump warns of further US action.

flash_696536.description:
New details emerging from the suspected murder of a 43-year-old woman in Petah Tikva indicate that her husband is suspected of killing her.

The husband was found approximately 100 meters from the scene, apparently after taking his own life.

flash_696534.description: StandWithUs condemns Saturday Night Live's Michael Che for joking about genocide during a segment on Israel's elections, accusing him of spreading anti-Israel lies.

flash_696532.description: Trump confirms discussing Iran with Netanyahu as reports suggest the two leaders disagree over when to resume military strikes against Tehran.

flash_696530.description: A private jet crashed into a mobile home park in South Florida on Sunday afternoon, triggering a massive fireball and destroying at least one residence.

flash_696528.description: Americans should ask themselves a question: Are we doing enough to protect the freedoms we inherited? Op-ed.

flash_696524.description: Right-wing protesters demonstrate outside Gadi Eisenkot's Herzliya home against cooperation with Arab parties, with one blaming him for his son's death.

flash_696522.description: US received intelligence that Iran is planning on harming President Trump

flash_696520.description: Former IDF Chief Herzi Halevi calls October 7 a preventable failure, rejects claims of internal betrayal, and acknowledges Israeli bombs killed hostages.

flash_696518.description: Democratic Rep. Haley Stevens has endorsed Republican Senate candidate Mike Rogers in Michigan, delivering a dramatic blow to her party's nominee, Abdul El-Sayed, just days before the November 3 midterm elections.

flash_696516.description:
Rep. Haley Stevens, D-Mich., endorsed Republican Senate candidate Mike Rogers in the race against Democratic candidate Abdul El-Sayed.

"Our Democratic nominee for US Senate, Abdul, said that I was no longer welcome in his campaign and that I should stay away," Stevens said in a video.

“And he’s right, and that’s why I am endorsing Mike Rogers for the United States Senate today," she said. “I don’t belong in Abdul’s campaign."

flash_696513.description: The President's Office invites Knesset factions for consultations ahead of the decision on whom to task with forming Israel's next government.

flash_696511.description: The Director General of the President's Office has invited representatives of the Knesset factions to a round of consultations ahead of the assignment of the mandate to form the next government.

flash_696509.description:
The leaders of Ra'am and the Joint List are expected to meet on Monday for the first time since the elections, aiming to coordinate their positions and political moves with the anti-Netanyahu bloc.

Both parties stated: "We will do everything to replace the Netanyahu government."

flash_696553.description: House Speaker Mike Johnson breaks into an impression of Donald Trump during an Iowa rally, reenacting the president's early-morning phone calls before realizing Trump is standing right behind him.

flash_696552.description: Sephardic Chief Rabbi David Yosef condemns baseless hatred and public divisions following the elections, urging Israelis to respect one another and strengthen Jewish unity.

flash_696550.description: The IDF eliminated two Hamas terrorists in separate strikes in Khan Yunis and Nuseirat, including a Nukhba terrorist who infiltrated Kibbutz Nir Oz during the October 7 massacre.

flash_696548.description: Hatred isolates it; optimism keeps it standing. Opinion.

flash_696546.description: Trump praises Democrat Haley Stevens for backing Republican Mike Rogers over Abdul El-Sayed in Michigan's Senate race and says he would welcome her into the GOP.

flash_696544.description: Trump is considering new strikes on Iran after the midterms while reportedly questioning his top military advisers, according to The Atlantic. The White House insists he retains full confidence.

flash_696542.description: Protesters in Indonesia target Andrea Bocelli over his support for Israel, but his concert goes ahead despite calls for cancellation by the country's top Islamic council.

flash_696540.description:
Diplomatic sources told Lebanon's Al-Jadeed television channel that Lebanon had received a warning that Israel could resume strikes on Beirut with an intensity similar to that seen during the worst days of the last war.

According to the report, the warning indicated that this time, the strikes could last for more than one day.

flash_696538.description:
Two young men were injured during violent disturbances in Beit Shemesh on Sunday night after allegedly pushing a concrete barrier that fell onto their legs.

Police said the incident occurred in an area where no officers were present and that their injuries were unrelated to police efforts to disperse the demonstration. Police added that two other people were evacuated for medical treatment after apparently being injured during the dispersal of protesters.

flash_696535.description:
A 43-year-old woman was found dead in Petah Tikva early Monday morning. Magen David Adom paramedics called to the scene found her without a pulse or signs of breathing and pronounced her dead at the scene.

Police have launched a murder investigation and are working to identify and locate those involved in the incident.

flash_696533.description:
US President Donald Trump said Sunday that the conflict with Iran would be brought to an end soon, either through a negotiated agreement or further American action.

"We've had such a victory and we'll put it away very soon, one way or the other. Either they'll make a deal or we'll just end it, end it the, I guess you could say, maybe the easy way," Trump said.

flash_696531.description: Hundreds of haredim protest the arrest of a newlywed draft evader sentenced to 20 days in military prison, with further demonstrations planned.

flash_696585.description: Starting November 14, direct trains will connect Hadera, Netanya and Beit Yehoshua to Jerusalem and Ben Gurion Airport, alongside major route changes.

flash_696584.description: Israel's National Cyber Directorate urges supermarket chains, food companies, and logistics centers to take immediate precautions after hackers in Europe remotely manipulated refrigeration systems, causing food spoilage, equipment damage, and fires.

flash_696582.description: President Herzog thanks Boy George for standing with Israel as the singer reflects on the personal cost of his support and meets former hostage Elkana Bohbot.

flash_696580.description:
Security forces conducted a renewed enforcement operation against several illegal structures built under a closed military zone next to the area of Salfit, where Israeli civilians have repeatedly engaged in violent and illegal activities.

Israeli rioters from the outpost set tires on fire and placed roadblocks on main roads in the area in an attempt to prevent forces from the enforcement operation. As a result, roads and main routes remained blocked throughout the morning, disrupting the daily lives of residents of the area and causing roadblocks and traffic congestion across all roads in the area. The security forces cleared the roadblocks in order to restore order in the area.

Throughout the operation, dozens of rioters engaged in physical and verbal violence against security forces, despite the forces' efforts to avoid physical confrontation.

flash_696579.description: “Is there anything too wondrous for God?"

flash_696577.description: An IDF aircraft crashed earlier today (Monday) in the Beit Shikma area following a technical malfunction, causing a fire in an open area. According to the IDF, there were no casualties in the incident, and its circumstances are being investigated.

flash_696575.description: In an urgent petition to the High Court of Justice, National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir alleges that Police Commissioner Danny Levy ordered officers to use increased force against haredi protesters even before the demonstrations began.

flash_696573.description: Three anti-Israel activists break into a British defense technology facility, smash equipment with sledgehammers, and are arrested following the attack.

flash_696571.description: Paris is burning and so few see through the Smoke Screen. Is America next? Opinion.

flash_696569.description: Avigdor Liberman alleges that the Palestinian Authority funded the Joint List and influenced Arab parties during Israel's elections, rejecting cooperation with them.

flash_696567.description: Ahavat Hashem Gordon's mother shares her journey from Hong Kong to Judaism, her unconventional parenting approach, and the values behind her son's Jewish pride.

flash_696565.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu accuses Israeli Left of hypocrisy over efforts to court haredi parties, reaffirming his support for Shas chair Aryeh Deri.

flash_696563.description: Abdul El-Sayed supporter tackled a Jewish girl during a free speech event at the University of Michigan, saying: 'I should have killed you when I had the chance.'

flash_696561.description: Mohammed Sweitat, 21 years old from Shfaram, arrested for spreading terrorist propaganda online, attemping to recruit supporters.

flash_696559.description: Dramatic cockpit recordings capture the crew's frantic warnings of a rapidly descending aircraft moments before the Learjet crashed in a residential area, killing all nine people aboard.

flash_696557.description:
A motorcyclist was caught traveling at 239 km/h (148.5 mph) on Route 70 before fleeing from police.

Police forces and a helicopter were deployed in pursuit. The helicopter located the 30-year-old suspect from Nazareth, leading to his arrest.

flash_696604.description: NYPD investigates after four Jewish school buses in Brooklyn were vandalized with swastikas and anti-Israel graffiti amid a rise in antisemitic incidents.

flash_696603.description:
US envoy Steve Witkoff announced that American representatives will meet in Brussels this week with officials from France, Germany, the United Kingdom, the European Union, and NATO.

Witkoff also said the United States will mediate talks between Russian and Ukrainian representatives, which are expected to take place in Abu Dhabi next week.

flash_696601.description: Saudi Defense Minister Khalid bin Salman spoke by phone with US Secretary of War Pete Hegseth about efforts to de-escalate and contain regional tensions, as well as the ongoing Houthi attacks against Saudi Arabia.

flash_696599.description: El-Sayed has helped lead a chapter of one MB offshoot, spoken at the conventions of three, and praised and raised money for a fourth. Report.

flash_696597.description:
Iran's IRNA news agency reported that five powerful explosions were heard in rapid succession on Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz.

A channel affiliated with the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) reported that air defense systems had been activated in the area.

flash_696595.description: Our elected officials take an oath to defend the Constitution, not to provide unconditional loyalty to a political organization. Opinion.

flash_696593.description: Elior Zandani, a former contestant on "The Next Star," says three men attacked him in Athens after hearing him speaking Hebrew.

flash_696591.description: British pop star visits the Western Wall with Sylvan Adams, places a prayer note between the stones, and reflects on his family.

flash_696589.description: As Michigan Democratic Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed doubles down on anti-Israel views, the choice for the state's Jews may seem obvious. Journalist Nate Friedman speaks to some to see if that's the case.

flash_696587.description: Senior Religious Zionist rabbis have issued a public statement following the Knesset elections, expressing firm opposition to the formation of a government that does not have the backing of a Jewish majority.

flash_696583.description: Evacuation of the "Ura Yisrael" hilltop outpost near Ariel: A Civil Administration bulldozer struck a residential building while several teenagers were sitting on its roof, causing them to fall.

flash_696581.description: Former PM Ehud Barak says the IDF cannot absorb all haredim and proposes national service for those who do not enlist, amid coalition negotiations.

flash_696578.description: Modern science helps us read the Torah’s blueprint, revealing an architecture within these laws that we would otherwise miss.

flash_696576.description: The Tanya compacts four millennia of Jewish wisdom to answer the great personal and existential questions of life. It has revolutionized the way we think about G -d the human soul, the world and our place in it.

flash_696622.description:
Iranian Speaker of Parliament Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf said: "The countries of the region must understand that Iran is fully prepared for war and that its finger is on the trigger."

He continued: "The ball is now in America's court, and it bears the responsibility for avoiding war. Attempts to force Iran into submission through threats and military maneuvers will not lead to its surrender. The era of imposing dictates is over. If America makes another strategic mistake, it should know that this time it will face a new battlefield and find itself even more vulnerable.

"The military strategy for confronting any potential attack has been determined by the Supreme Commander of the Armed Forces, and our response will be unpredictable and without geographical limitations," Ghalibaf added.

flash_696621.description: Shimon Elkabetz, whose daughter Sivan was murdered with her partner in Kfar Aza, questioned why Herzi Halevi is being given such a prominent platform to explain the October 7th massacre.

flash_696619.description: Message to the Iranian dissident: Living outside Iran does not, by itself, make you safe. The danger may be your neighbor or colleague. Opinion.

flash_696617.description: An Uzi submachine gun, retired by the IDF over 30 years ago, is returned anonymously as a nationwide weapons drive collects over 10,000 items on its first day.

flash_696615.description:
Deni Avdija and the Portland Trail Blazers secured an impressive 118-110 road victory over the Denver Nuggets, improving their record to 5-1. Denver fell to 3-3.

Avdija scored 28 points, three rebounds, and five assists. Denver star Nikola Jokic finished with 26 points, nine rebounds, and eight assists.

flash_696613.description: Yoaz Hendel vows to return after narrowly missing the electoral threshold, blasts talks with haredi parties, and calls for a Netanyahu-Bennett-Eisenkot government.

flash_696611.description: Trump tells Sean Hannity the US could strike Iran's Pickaxe Mountain nuclear site within an hour, while insisting Tehran wants a deal and the fighting is not a war.

flash_696609.description: NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani and Gov. Kathy Hochul condemn swastikas and antisemitic graffiti on Jewish school buses in Brooklyn, demanding accountability.

flash_696607.description:
A senior US official commented to Axios on the American strike in Iran, reported overnight by The Wall Street Journal, saying that a US military fighter jet struck and destroyed a surface-to-air missile launcher on Iran's Qeshm Island.

According to the official, the strike was carried out in self-defense after Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) fired an anti-aircraft missile from the launcher.

flash_696606.description: The Wall Street Journal reports that the US struck Iran's Qeshm Island Monday as part of a weeks-long campaign of limited attacks kept secret to avoid escalation.

flash_696602.description: Hackers remotely took control of refrigeration systems in Europe, causing food spoilage and fires. Israel's National Cyber Directorate warns supermarket chains.

flash_696600.description: VP JD Vance says talks with Iran are progressing and no deadline has been set, but insists Tehran must verifiably commit not to rebuild its nuclear program.

flash_696598.description: Trump says Iran is seeking an agreement with Washington, citing falling oil prices and US military gains while predicting a deal with Tehran could be reached.

flash_696596.description: Shin Bet chief David Zini reportedly accuses legal advisers of delaying the election interference probe as the Attorney General demands additional evidence.

flash_696594.description: Women are obligated to broaden and deepen their study of Torah and halakha, while understanding the internal logic of the Torah as it emerges from the Talmud and its commentators.

flash_696659.description: Zehut Party chairman Moshe Feiglin expressed hope that President Trump will follow through on his pledge to end American financial aid to Israel, arguing that the assistance comes at the expense of Israeli sovereignty.

flash_696658.description: MK Saada: The chances of forming a change government with the Arab parties and haredim are virtually zero. Members of Eisenkot's party tell me they would oppose such a move. It's either a unity government or elections.

flash_696656.description: The Election Committee expected 650,000 double-envelope votes, but counted only 451,000 due to a last-minute IDF decision.

flash_696654.description:
The Secretary of Iran's Supreme National Security Council, Mohsen Rezaei, stated that the United States' response regarding Iran's rights and demands was unconvincing.

He said that the United States must provide a full, clear, and explicit response to all seven conditions set by Iran.

flash_696652.description: The Torah’s prohibitions assume our capacity for self-control. Hashem emphasized this: “Sin lies at the doorway…but you can control it."

flash_696650.description: In a conversation at the i24NEWS studios, comedian and pro-Israel activist Yechiel Jacobs revealed the threats against his family, the unexpected success of his videos, and why he believes humor can reach audiences traditional advocacy cannot.

flash_696648.description: Shas's Council of Torah Sages has decided to recommend Benjamin Netanyahu to President Isaac Herzog as its candidate to form the next government.

flash_696646.description: The questions he has never answered, essays he pulled from public view, a deleted 9/11 post, three refusals to say Israel has a right to exist, a refusal to name the IRGC to an Iranian-American whose family it hunted, and a 2011 defense of the Brotherhood he has never retracted. Report.

flash_696644.description:
US President Donald Trump said today in an interview with Fox News: "Netanyahu and I agreed that we would give Israel $4 billion a year, and we made a deal months ago that we would stop paying them, and they are fine with that - they don't need us. We will not pay Israel any more."

Read more

flash_696642.description: Opposition party leaders agreed to recommend Gadi Eisenkot to the president to form the next government and immediately begin coalition negotiations.

flash_696640.description: Starting tomorrow, the Shin Bet's State Personal Security Unit (Unit 730) will provide security for Yashar party chairman Gadi Eisenkot.

flash_696638.description: After eight months of fighting in Lebanon, IDF commanders recount the battles, the tunnels uncovered, and their advance to the Beaufort ridge.

flash_696636.description:
The Zehut party, led by Moshe Feiglin, which joined forces with Bezalel Smotrich's Religious Zionist party, has requested to participate separately in the consultations with President Isaac Herzog ahead of the formation of the next government.

Read more.

flash_696635.description:
The meeting between the Change Bloc party leaders concluded after approximately an hour. Together party chairman Naftali Bennett said following the meeting:

"We have no time. We need to act with great urgency. Therefore, as quickly as possible, we will take control of the Knesset speakership, secure the mandate to form a government, and act as swiftly as possible to establish a Zionist government of reform, bring about a revolution for those who serve, and begin repairing the country. The entire Together party will fully mobilize to help Gadi Eisenkot form a government as soon as possible."

flash_696633.description: Joint List leaders Ahmad Tibi and Yousef Jabareen met this morning with Democrats chairman Yair Golan.

flash_696631.description: With over 57 million ballots already cast, Americans vote in crucial midterm elections that could reshape Trump's agenda and US policy toward Israel and Iran.

flash_696673.description: After false alarm confirmed, Mano Cruises passengers allowed to return to ship in Greece

flash_696672.description:
Attorney General Gali Baharav-Miara clarified that citizens and elected officials cannot be investigated without evidence justifying such an investigation.

"If the Shin Bet or any other body possesses evidence warranting an investigation, it is welcome to present it. Anyone who needs to be investigated will be investigated," a statement issued on her behalf said.

The statement also alleged that the Shin Bet has failed for two days to transfer the evidence it collected to the special investigative team established on the recommendation of Justice Sohlberg, in cooperation with the police and under the supervision of the State Attorney's Office, thereby delaying the investigation.

flash_696671.description: The High Court has ruled that the young man convicted of killing Aisha al-Rabi in 2018 will not begin serving his prison sentence until his appeal has been decided.

flash_696670.description: Only 34% of the public prefer another round of elections, while 74% oppose a minority government led by Gadi Eisenkot and relying on Arab parties.

flash_696668.description: Shin Bet Director David Zini is seeking to question Ahmad Tibi, Mansour Abbas, Sami Abu Shehadeh, and another Knesset member under caution. The Attorney General is demanding evidence before approving the move.

flash_696666.description: Israel has reportedly shared intelligence with the United States suggesting that Iran intends to use chemical weapons against its adversaries.

flash_696664.description: Greece: All passengers evacuated from ship amid suspected bomb threat

flash_696662.description: Visiting Israel at Adams’ invitation, the British music icon meets survivors and bereaved families ahead of two Tel Aviv concerts, including a performance dedicated to the Nova community.

flash_696661.description: Visiting Israel at Adams’ invitation, the British music icon meets survivors and bereaved families ahead of two Tel Aviv concerts, including a performance dedicated to the Nova community.

flash_696657.description: After eight months of operations in the Wadi Saluki, Qantara, and Litani areas, troops from the IDF's 7th Brigade have completed their mission in southern Lebanon.

flash_696655.description:
Residents of Nevatim in southern Israel reported bullet impacts on the walls of their homes and on vehicles near a playground, following reports of gunfire in the area, Channel 12 News correspondent Itay Gal-On reported.

"I came back from shopping and saw a bullet hole," said Alex, a local resident. "A week or two ago, there was heavy gunfire in the surrounding communities. Unfortunately, that's nothing new. Then I heard a very loud bang, and apparently this is what happened. We need an Iron Dome here in our community."

flash_696653.description: A 26-year-old man has been charged with fatally running over his coworker at a factory in northern Israel while operating a forklift without a license and under the influence of alcohol. The incident was caught on camera.

flash_696651.description: The Religious Zionism party announced that it will recommend Benjamin Netanyahu to form the next government tomorrow and call for an end to the boycotts imposed by left-wing parties.

flash_696649.description: Military correspondent Doron Kadosh says President Trump appears to be accelerating plans to end decades of US military aid to Israel; but this does not come as a big surprise.'

flash_696647.description:
Channel 13 diplomatic correspondent Moriah Asraf warned that the timing of US President Donald Trump's announcement of the end of aid to Israel is a worrying sign of how Israel's standing in the US has fallen.

"What is more troubling than the move itself, which, as noted, was coordinated with Israel, is the fact that Trump is saying this on the eve of the midterm elections. In other words, it's popular," Asraf said. "This paints a troubling and worrying picture of Israel's standing."
